Undercoop archive decoder26.05 modifications (2026-10-23)

The upstream7zip source/license files are retained. Undercoop additions in
C/UndercoopBudget.c, C/UndercoopBudget.h and CPP/Common/UndercoopBudgetCpp.cpp
are licensed LGPL-2.1-or-later and distributed as source with this decoder.

Only the Format7zF DLL build defines UNDERCOOP_ARCHIVE_BUDGET. Under that macro:
- C/Alloc.c routes MyAlloc/MyRealloc/MyFree, MidAlloc/MidFree and BigAlloc/Free
  into a DLL-local, atomically accounted allocation guard.
- C++new/new[], nothrow and sized-delete variants use the same allocator.
  Aligned-new/delete variants are supplied when the compiler enables them.
- Maximum requested allocation is128MiB. Maximum live payload plus prefixed
  headers/alignment charges is256MiB across all decoder-owned guarded blocks.
- Regular blocks are at least16-byte aligned; Mid/Big blocks remain page
  aligned. Reallocation failure preserves the original block and contents.
- Rejection occurs before calling HeapAlloc, including decoder dictionaries,
  encoded-header buffers and C++container allocations. No process allocator
  hooks, security exclusions, changes to the game heap or Windows runtime
  allocator replacement are used.
- Native COM/BSTR interfaces retain the system's own allocation conventions;
  caller-owned BSTRs/callbacks are not passed to the guarded block free routine.

Format7zF/makefile adds the two allocation guard objects and uses its own
UndercoopArchive.def to retain normal7zip exports and add private diagnostic
exports. Other upstream bundle/export files are not changed by this override.
scratch/BuildArchiveEngine61215.bat forces a complete rebuild, preventing a
mixture of stale unguarded and newly guarded object files.

Verification:523 archive-format/safety checks plus291 direct/parallel allocator
checks pass. The latter reject1GiB ordinary/C++allocations and two real malicious
dictionary headers (standaloneLZMA and an encoded7z header), enforce aggregate
limits and verify live allocation/free counters return to their baseline after
ordinary7z/ZIP64/tgz/txz/RAR4/RAR5solid decoding as well as failed decodes.
